nodes.asset_description: A pair of light blue jeans with distressed detailing, including rips and fading, are shown against a black background. The jeans are positioned with the legs slightly apart and the waistband visible. The image is presented in a flat, two-dimensional style.

A pair of light tan, lace-up shoes with thick black soles are shown against a white background. The shoes are positioned slightly angled, with the soles facing upward. The laces are black and threaded through the eyelets. The shoes appear to be made of a smooth material.

A white handbag with gold-colored hardware is shown against a black background. The bag has a rectangular shape with rounded edges and features two top handles connected by gold-colored metal hardware. The front panel of the bag is white with visible stitching and subtle texture.

A blue denim jacket hangs on a metal hanger against a black background. The jacket features two chest pockets, two front pockets, and long sleeves with buttoned cuffs. The denim material has a slightly faded or worn appearance.

A pair of tortoiseshell sunglasses with gradient lenses, resting on a black background. The lenses transition from a lighter shade at the top to a darker shade at the bottom. The frame is dark brown or black and has a slightly angular shape.
A short-sleeved polo shirt with horizontal orange and white stripes is shown against a black background. The shirt has a white collar and short sleeves.
